random_short_side_scale_jitter: perform spatial short scale jittering on video frames with configurable min and max size bounds
random_crop: perform random spatial crop on video frames to a specified square size with optional bounding box adjustment
uniform_crop: perform uniform spatial sampling on video frames using left, center, or right crop strategy
horizontal_flip: perform horizontal flip on video frames with configurable probability and optional bounding box transformation
color_jitter: perform color jittering on video frames with configurable brightness, contrast, and saturation parameters
